test_title: PYST 38: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 13 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The party was a ________ hour for everyone, except Mukesh.
solution:
The correct answer is '**happy**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**happy**'.
 
• The phrase **"a happy hour"** means that the party was enjoyable for everyone, except Mukesh.<
